name: chimera-emulation-runtime

layers.persistent_media: ROMs, disk images and firmware are represented as file-backed media.
layers.runtime_emulator: An emulator is an object-backed runtime service with lifecycle state.
layers.authorization: Koronos capabilities authorize access to media, emulator processes and host resources.
layers.presentation: Aurora consumes emulator/media metadata and exposes launchable entries.

resolution: recursively scan media and compute SHA-256
classify BIOS/ROM/media using extension plus optional content signature
resolve compatible emulator candidates from the canonical known-emulators catalog
